about 25 years.

I did a video about milkweed and how the Ogallala Down Company was trying to develop a milkweed industry,back in the early 90s. We even flew out to Wyoming to show a family collecting the pods on the High Plains. I struck up a conversation with a Mesquaki tribe member one time. I asked him if he ever ate milkweed pods. He broke out in a big smile and said “oh man, my mom made the best fried milk pod sandwiches when I was growing up!”

The duvets are very warm yet very light. You really don’t need another blanket. I would recommend it a decent duvet cover to keep it clean. Resend them to a specialized laundry service in Kansas City each year. They have gotten a lot more expensive since then.

Indeed!

Thank you very much for the info!
